name: Question 2
problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14144324/assets/6681be6a003aa430f35f87cbb65dfecd2b57e274760f40cc8519ebfa73b63203.png)

What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?
worked_solution:
The vertex of a downward-opening parabola is the highest point of the parabola.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14144324/assets/48a98490f4167beb690d17ccc63a0b0bf64aed83363c80283cf596fd839ad642.png)

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are $(0,6).$

Question 2
?

What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?

a
(0,−6)
b
(6,0)
c
(0,6)
d
(−6,0)
e
(0,8)
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

The vertex of a downward-opening parabola is the highest point of the parabola.

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are (0,6).
